# dependent -> wait-target
# One section per fixture. Edges alphabetical inside the section.
# Checker only asserts these exist (extra edges are allowed).
# Groups have no edges.

# base
base -> base_install

# backend-pick
be-pick -> be-pick_install

# dep
dep -> dep_install
dep_configure -> base_install

# dup-link
dup-a -> dup-a_install

dup-b -> dup-b_install

# file-to-component
